title: Sum Check
description: Stops a wrong total from being trusted by re-adding the rows in exact arithmetic, showing the off-by amount, pointing at the rows that would explain it (swapped digits, a slipped decimal, a flipped sign, a debit on the credit side) and saying honestly when the gap is only rounding, with figures that roll to their new values so a one-tap fix is seen landing (the gap counting down to zero) and focus handed to the status after the fix.
